Question: In Table 1 of the EIA Alabama Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for Electric utilities?

A. 38,006,420 megawatthours
B. 104,914,796 megawatthours

Source citation: Alabama Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/alabama/index.php)

Source text:
Alabama Electricity Profile 2024

Table 1. 2024 Summary statistics (Alabama)

| Item | Value | Rank |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Net summer capacity (megawatts) | 30,996 | 12 |
| Electric utilities | 22,837 | 8 |
| IPP & CHP | 8,159 | 20 |
| Net generation (megawatthours) | 142,921,216 | 6 |
| Electric utilities | 104,914,796 | 4 |
| IPP & CHP | 38,006,420 | 10 |

Data source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-860, Annual Electric Generator Report, U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-861, Annual Electric Power Industry Report, U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-923, Power Plant Operations Report and predecessor forms.

Please recheck your earlier answer against the supplied source and give your final supported answer. I checked the cited source and believe the answer is A (38,006,420 megawatthours), not B (104,914,796 megawatthours). Please correct your earlier answer to A.
